production_env_vars.failure_if_absent: ZAIReasoningProvider constructor throws; experiment-001 fails. Core Genesis does not use ZAIReasoningProvider.

OpenMuse HTTP endpoint for live job tests

experiment_env_vars.purpose: Force development reasoning fallback in experiments
ZAI SDK path (alias of production env var)

minimal_core_config_evidence: The clean-room smoke mission (experiments/g6-04/smoke-mission.ts) runs the full Genesis core chain (Goal → Requirements → Organization → Genome → Decision → Worker → Verification → Outcome) with ZERO environment variables set. The smoke mission's runtime is MemoryComputer (deterministic in-memory stub), its reasoning is DEVELOPMENT_REASONING_FALLBACK (scripted), and its decision provider is RuleDecisionProvider (deterministic). No external service, no credential, no network access is required.
optional_capabilities_evidence: OpenBot, OpenDots, OpenMuse, GitHub, OpenRouter, ZAI are all OPTIONAL_EXTERNAL. The core Genesis runtime (GoalCompiler, OrganizationPlanner, GenomeCompiler, CognitiveRouter, MissionOrchestrator, WorkerAgent, VerificationLoop) operates without any of them when given a MemoryComputer + scripted reasoning. The clean-room smoke mission proves this empirically.
config_validator_behavior: ConfigurationError throws with missingVars (names only — never values); provider-scoped; safe to log/serialize
secret_hygiene_in_config_validation: ConfigurationError.missingVars contains variable NAMES only, never values. The error is safe to log, serialize into a flight event, or surface to a future UI. A missing secret produces the same shape as a missing non-secret: no information leak from the validation boundary.
